journey.title: Contributor consent and withdrawal
journey.purpose: Demonstrate the accepted contributor consent and withdrawal outcome with exact identities, authority and adverse branches.

steps.intent: Inspect included/excluded bounded packet and permitted recipient/use.
Record verified response and contributor-controlled final wording and scoped consent.
Withdraw before local/provider/in-flight/already-published branches without claiming instant external removal.
Surface responsible actor and actual route control/reconciliation evidence.
